1.en_consolidated_definition:
To disassemble or dismantle something, often in a careless or haphazard manner, typically referring to the process of taking apart an object or structure that is no longer useful or has been abandoned.

Nota: La palabra "desvencijar" es un término coloquial en español puertorriqueño que se refiere a la acción de desmontar o desarmar algo, especialmente estructuras o edificios abandonados.
